dedupe_keys.name: pokryti tranzitnich zeleznicnich koridoru mobilnim signalem

description: Pokrytí tranzitních železničních koridorů mobilním signálem is a dataset listed in Czech National Open Data Portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Český telekomunikační úřad. Výstup z měření pokrytí tranzitních železničních koridorů mobilním signálem, které proběhlo v dubnu 2016. Coverage: Český telekomunikační úřad. The publisher named on the listing is Český telekomunikační úřad. Its keywords include železniční koridory, LTE, GPS, pokrytí signálem, T-mobile, UMTS. The listing shows 5 download or service links in CSV, TXT. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://data.gov.cz/zdroj/datové-sady/70106975/42d1bdd90436d3cb1c1a2289608f2537/distribuce/6bfb66450d2474b99506ba1afbdd5393/podmínky-užití). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nkod-opendata-cz.
